questionText:
Let $n$ be an odd number greater than 100. Consider a binary minheap with $n$ elements stored in an array $P$ whose index starts from 1.

Which of the following indices of $P$ do/does NOT correspond to any leaf node of the minheap?
explanation:
Step 1: Determine the Range of Leaf and Non-Leaf Nodes
In a 1-indexed binary heap array of size $n$, the left child of a node at index $i$ is located at $2i$. A node is an internal (non-leaf) node if it has at least one child, meaning $2i \le n$, which simplifies to $i \le \lfloor n/2 \rfloor$.

Step 2: Simplify for Odd $n$
Since $n$ is an odd number, $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor = \frac{n - 1}{2}$.

• Internal (Non-leaf) Node Indices: $1, 2, \dots, \frac{n - 1}{2}$
• Leaf Node Indices: $\frac{n + 1}{2}, \frac{n + 3}{2}, \dots, n$

Step 3: Evaluate the Options
• Option (A) $\frac{n + 1}{2}$: Corresponds to the first leaf node.
• Option (B) $\frac{n - 1}{2}$: Corresponds to the last internal node, so it is NOT a leaf node.
• Option (C) $\frac{n - 3}{2}$: Since $\frac{n - 3}{2} < \frac{n - 1}{2}$, this is an internal node, so it is NOT a leaf node.
• Option (D) $n$: Corresponds to the last leaf node.

Therefore, the options that do NOT correspond to a leaf node are B and C.
